not_adopted.category: Should Not Be Verbatim (S34, Substitution subtype (a))
not_adopted.quote: Some part of the input has been copied verbatim to the output, but should have been rendered differently.
not_adopted.reason_in_his_words: tak posledni ohledne citace a sumarizace mi prijde vysoce subjektivni
not_adopted.why_that_is_right: The category turns on when a note is required to render rather than quote, and the paper does not say. Nothing in the definition distinguishes a quotation that carries the client's own words usefully from one that should have been a formulation, so every observation would be the rater's taste. The other three accepted categories each have a decidable comparison behind them: a number, a name, or a source that is itself wrong.
not_adopted.what_would_change_it: A written rule naming the cases in which a session note must render rather than quote. K15, the necessity of a sensitive detail, is the nearest thing the catalog has and it has no source either.
